history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Department of Political Affairs work with all involved entities to develop a target operating model for the provision of support to all special political missions that clearly defines roles and responsibilities, the resources required and how performance would be measured.
history.administration_response: The Department of Political Affairs already has a service level agreement with the Department of Field Support that clearly defines the model of special political missions supported by the Department of Field Support. Performance is measured through the compacts of each head of mission. Surveys done by the various service centres help with performance measurement.
history.board_assessment: The Administration’s response does not address the Board’s recommendation, made as a result of the findings contained in paragraphs 164-168 of chapter II of its previous report. At the time of the previous audit, there was no current, formal or documented design of the special political mission operating model regardless of cluster (not just field-based entities). The Board concluded that the service level agreement with the Department of Field Support did not adequately address its concerns, hence the recommendation. The Board has seen no evidence that this situation has progressed, and on this basis concludes that the recommendation is not implemented.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Department of Political Affairs work with all involved entities to develop a target operating model for the provision of support to all special political missions that clearly defines roles and responsibilities, the resources required and how performance would be measured.
history.administration_response: Beyond the service level agreement that the Department of Political Affairs has agreed upon with the Department of Field Support, the Department of Political Affairs, in coordination with relevant departments as deemed necessary, has issued a number of guidance documents to provide instructions to staff and managers in different aspects of their interaction with and support of special political missions. These include a special political missions start-up manual, Headquarters support to special political missions guidelines for desk officers; guidelines on strategic assessment; in-briefing and debriefing of senior leaders and special envoys; an integrated assessment and planning handbook; guidelines on mission concept; and guidance on United Nations police in peacekeeping operations and special political missions. A number of policies, guidelines and standard operating procedures address specific aspects of activities and support provided to special political missions, from security for United Nations personnel, assets and premises to electoral assistance and mediation.
history.board_assessment: While noting the actions initiated by the Administration, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.

history.sg_progress: This recommendation has been overtaken by events, given the recent initiatives of the Secretary-General to launch reforms in the peace and security and management architectures. A management review of the Secretariat-wide support arrangements is currently being conducted, and it will affect the support arrangements for special political missions. The Board is therefore requested to close this recommendation.
